en: Vintage sepia-toned postcard with two main illustration panels. The left panel shows the ornate façade of a multi‑story hotel-restaurant building in a late 19th / early 20th century style, with bay windows, balconies, and decorative stucco. The right panel depicts the interior dining hall with chandeliers, detailed ceiling ornamentation, a bar stocked with bottles and glassware, and rows of neatly set tables and chairs. Between the panels is an Art Nouveau floral motif in brown and red. Around the printed images, the card is filled with handwritten cursive text in German. The bottom right has the printed title of the establishment in red.
